news.title: Times Higher Education to wind down BMI by end of 2026
news.summary_en: Times Higher Education (THE) is closing the BMI GlobalEd arm of its business, citing pressure on the international education sector that has made "business hard to sustain".
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Irish court overturns Gazan student visa refusal over “significant errors”
news.summary_en: The Irish High Court has overturned a decision to refuse a study visa to a 20-year-old Palestinian woman, following "significant and demonstrable errors" in the refusal decision by the Department of Justice.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: Australia consults on student visa overhaul as refusals hit key markets
news.summary_en: Proposals would revise the Genuine Student requirement and financial-capacity rules, including possible Australian bank accounts and tougher evidence for certain international student applicants.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: The PIE Live Germany – live feed
news.summary_en: Follow along here for live updates from The PIE Live Germany conference.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert

news.title: In an age of AI, character matters more than ever – so why do too many schools leave it to chance?
news.summary_en:
AI has put extraordinary capability in every student’s hands. But are schools giving young people the
values to decide what to do with it, asks David Harkin.
news.author: David Harkin

news.title: Brazil’s study abroad ambitions widen, but information gap holds back demand
news.summary_en: Growing interest in Europe, expanding bilingual schooling and demand for shorter overseas experiences are reshaping Brazil’s outbound student market, according to speakers preparing for The PIE High Brazil.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: English UK launches student protection review after provider closures
news.summary_en: English UK has launched a major review of student protection arrangements following a series of large-scale provider closures that have exposed gaps in existing safeguards for international students.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Positively Languages launches with new London and Malta premises
news.summary_en: Positively Languages, formerly Kaplan Languages Group, has formally launched its new brand alongside opening new English language schools in Malta and London.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Australia loses ground to UK and US in international student race
news.summary_en: Australia is losing ground to the UK and US as a preferred study destination, according to new data from IDP Education.
news.author: Jenna O'Flynn

news.title: UK unis to take £1,010m hit over international student levy
news.summary_en: The UK's upcoming levy on international student fees will batter universities' bottom lines by £110 million more than previously anticipated, according to a new government impact assessment.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Breaking: UK to extend graduate visa to two years for graduates of “high-compliance universities”
news.summary_en: The UK government will extend the graduate visa to two years for international graduates of “high-compliance universities” with strong labour market outcomes, according to its 2026 Budget.
news.author: Kim Martin
